adminDashboard.title: System Administration & Governance Cockpit
adminDashboard.subtitle: Centralized governance, business parameter configuration, access delegation, and security audit monitoring.
adminDashboard.bannerNotice: Configuration parameters and permission rules in this prototype are managed in client state for operational demonstration. In production, authorization policies and immutable audit trails are enforced by server-side policy engines.
adminDashboard.descParams: Configure cancellation windows, refund rates, deposit percentages, and dietary cutoff rules.
adminDashboard.descFlags: Safely toggle modular services including extra dining, extra spa, and statutory export routines.
adminDashboard.descMatrix: Inspect cross-role capability assignments and enforce immutable privacy & least-privilege boundaries.
adminDashboard.descDelegation: Grant strictly scoped, time-bounded administrative capabilities to Resort Operations Manager (Sarah Jenkins).
adminDashboard.descAudit: Review chronological metadata of access events involving health, identity, and financial records.
adminDashboard.descOverview: High-level cross-module operational health and daily Police Residence Declaration compliance export.
adminDashboard.ruleBr01Desc: A spa session requires concurrent availability of both an eligible Therapist and an assigned Treatment Room. Cannot be bypassed by parameters or feature flags.
adminDashboard.ruleBr02Title: BR-02: Consolidated Folio Settlement Before Checkout
adminDashboard.ruleBr02Desc: Front Desk checkout cannot be finalized while any unpaid extra Spa or F&B charges remain on the villa folio. Unpaid balance check is non-bypassable.
adminDashboard.ruleBr03Title: BR-03: Sensitive Health & Dietary Data Minimization
adminDashboard.ruleBr03Desc: Therapists see only physical contraindications; Chefs see only culinary allergen tags; Receptionists and Managers are blocked from medical records.
adminDashboard.ruleBr06Title: BR-06: Manager Least Privilege & Role Separation
adminDashboard.ruleBr06Desc: Manager is strictly executive reporting. Manager never inherits full Admin rights and receives only explicitly delegated, time-bounded capabilities.
adminDashboard.descStaff: Manage staff accounts, clearance roles, active work status, and RBAC security boundaries (Screens 10 & 11).
adminDashboard.descMasterData: Administer retreat packages, spa therapy services, and villa categories with wellness taxonomy (Screen 12).

params.pageSubtitle: Configure operational limits, deposit requirements, cancellation cutoff windows, and statutory batch export timing.
params.safetyNoticeDesc: Core wellness resort safety controls—including 2D Spa resource matching (Therapist + Room), checkout settlement blocks on unpaid charges, and sensitive health data minimization—are hard-coded architectural invariants and cannot be overridden by parameter modifications.
params.savedToast: Parameter successfully updated and logged to audit trail

flags.pageSubtitle: Safely activate or deactivate supported customer self-service modules and automated regulatory compliance export routines.
flags.safetyDesc: Core security invariants (such as RBAC data minimization, 2D therapist+room booking validations, and folio settlement checks) are essential architecture controls and are deliberately excluded from feature flag toggles.
flags.confirmPrompt: You are about to change the operational state of:
flags.confirmAuditNote: This state transition will take effect immediately in the prototype and append a timestamped event to the Sensitive Governance Audit Log.

matrix.pageSubtitle: Cross-role functional capability allocations, operational clearance boundaries, and sensitive data minimization invariants.
matrix.legendDesc: Cells marked with lock icons represent non-negotiable data minimization boundaries required by Vietnam Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, Law on Residence 2020, and resort financial controls. Manager permissions are strictly read-only reporting unless delegated.

delegation.pageTitle: Limited Admin Rights Delegation to Manager
delegation.pageSubtitle: Grant temporary, tightly scoped operational capabilities to Resort Operations Manager (Sarah Jenkins) without conferring unrestricted Admin authority.
delegation.safeguardDesc: Delegation is strictly restricted to approved operational functions. Administrative credential management, RBAC matrix reconfiguration, security audit review, and sub-delegation powers CANNOT be delegated to Manager.
delegation.revokePrompt: Are you sure you want to revoke delegation record
delegation.revokeNotice: The delegated capability will immediately cease to be available to Sarah Jenkins. The record will remain archived in the delegation history and a revocation event will be committed to the Sensitive Governance Audit Log.
delegation.errorNoCaps: Select at least one delegable capability.
delegation.errorNoReason: Operational justification reason is mandatory for audit logging.
delegation.createdSuccess: Limited delegation successfully granted to Sarah Jenkins (Manager)
delegation.revokedSuccess: Delegation revoked immediately. Audit event recorded.

audit.pageTitle: Sensitive Data Access & Governance Audit Log

audit.minimizationTitle: Strict Metadata Logging & Sensitive Data Minimization
audit.minimizationDesc: To protect customer confidentiality, this audit log records access metadata and pseudonymous references only. Raw health diagnoses, specific allergy symptoms, passport/identity numbers, and payment credentials are NEVER stored or exposed in audit records.

boundaries.auditAdminOnly: Accountability: Audit trail inspection reserved exclusively for System Administrator.
